known_outcome: Council answer (leakage): ratings are determined either by testing under the Washington amendment to Section 703.2 where the connection is part of the fire-resistance test, or by engineering analysis approved by the code official; for this purpose the connection includes connectors, fasteners and the wood portions included in the structural design; officials may use ICC 2021 Group B proposal S170-19 for guidance.
review_focus: definition of the connection that the rating covers
approval of the analysis by the code official
administrative evidence a submission would need
